title: Somnium Engine P-003 — L2 verifier gate (causal semantics adversarial pass)
description: Independent L2 review of P-003 (branch causal, commits d664b4c / 834c1ff / fa572f7 / 5bd65a9 on merged baseline bb2a527). Three gates: REJECT, REJECT, APPROVE. Both rejections were on documentation asserting a claim the change refuted; the second also exposed a substantive hash-identity unsoundness.

findings: F1 (doc-contradicts-code): three docstrings claimed the hash never folds the intervention list into a sorted form while canonicalInterventions did exactly that.

F2 (unsound claim asserted as measured): severEdge+addEdge classed as set-like and hashed commutatively; they do not commute on a load-bearing edge, so two different worlds shared one hash with different interventions provenance.
gate_history.other_claims: all PASS (six defects confirmed, judgment model, staged propagation with monotonicity throw, relation semantics, cases A-K, graphDistance rename behaviour-preserving, no auto-repair, determinism)

findings: F2 behaviour verified closed by execution.

F1 not closed: the repo-wide claim search missed world-state.ts:312-313, which still read 'graph-level interventions as a sorted set (they commute)' in the comment annotating the hashState call, contradicting SET_LIKE_KINDS twelve lines above.
Secondary (non-blocking): propagation.ts:4 said 'four defects' where the report says six.

gate_history.note: Exhaustive repo-wide claim search over ten refuted terms with a per-hit judgement (accurate / historical / surviving): zero surviving refuted claims. F2 behaviour re-confirmed by the verifier's own execution across four probes.
